cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Committee,

I am a computer engineer and lecturer who has spent the last few years building and evaluating AI systems for language tasks. In my PhD work I created hybrid evaluation metrics for Turkish text summarisation, combining extractive methods with large language models and testing them on real-world medical documents. This required designing tasks, curating data, and defining success criteria, the same steps you describe for evaluation development.

At Toros University I led the SmartLab Technology Center, where I managed projects that turned research prototypes into usable tools, such as an LLM-based disinformation detector and a utility-model for smart refrigerators. I coordinated interdisciplinary teams, sourced annotation resources, and ensured data privacy across collaborations, mirroring the cross-functional work you expect.

I have also contributed to EU COST projects on trustworthy AI and medical imaging, where I built evaluation pipelines and reported results to scientists and engineers. Those experiences taught me how to calibrate task difficulty and make evaluation outcomes actionable for model training decisions.

I look forward to bringing my hands-on research background and project leadership to the Prosus AI team, helping shape the next generation of evaluation platforms.

Best regards,
Anıl Kuş
